title: Pan-Seared Korean-Style Asparagus with Lemon-Tahini Sauce
description: A flavorful and refreshing side dish made with tender asparagus, a tangy lemon-tahini sauce, and a hint of Korean chili flakes. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner or as a accompaniment to your favorite meal.
instructions: 1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the asparagus for 3-5 minutes, or until tender.
2. Remove the asparagus from the water and set aside to cool.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, ghee or oil, soy sauce, and chili flakes until smooth.
4. Add the cooled asparagus to the bowl and toss to coat with the lemon-tahini sauce.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
